source: the game's own manual and thirty-year-old muscle memory, written down before the runs that use it
notes: The wall at the end of the jungle is destroyed by its cannons and the sensor between them; point-blank diagonal fire is what reaches them.
A base stage does not scroll. Its exit opens when the room's sensor is destroyed, and the way on is upward through the door.
Flying capsules carry weapons; shooting one and walking into what it drops is worth a detour.
Once a room's sensor is destroyed the way on is upward through the door, so a cleared room rewards moving up the screen.
